text: Aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid) irreversibly inhibits PTGS1 (COX-1) by covalently acetylating a specific serine residue (Ser530) within the enzyme's active site. This modification sterically hinders the binding of arachidonic acid, thereby preventing the synthesis of pro-inflammatory prostaglandins that mediate pain and inflammation.
